ns2:section.sectionText: Photography as Methodology for Undergraduate Research in Diversity and Sustainability Photography is a fantastic medium to help people understand the world around them. Photographic storytelling is a compelling way to draw people into research and its results. This class will use photojournalism as social documentary to expose students to visual methods of research. Diversity and sustainability will be the core topics of the photgraphic research projects students will complete during this semester-long hands-on class. No prior photographic experience is required. Cameras provided if needed. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
